issues.summary: Revert or fix the dead wiki.ubuntu.com full-disk-encryption link
issues.detail: docs/explanation/security.md:110 changes the FDE link from help.ubuntu.com/community/... to https://wiki.ubuntu.com/Full_Disk_Encryption_Howto_2019, which returns HTTP 404 (the relaunched Ubuntu wiki did not migrate legacy Community Help pages). The URL is not in linkcheck_ignore, so `make -C docs linkcheck` flags it; two reviewers suggest the maintained https://documentation.ubuntu.com/security/security-features/storage/encryption-full-disk page instead.

issues.summary: Correct the inverted proselint rationale or restate the PR
issues.detail: No proselint check flags the U+2019 apostrophe; proselint's only quote rule (typography.symbols.curly_quotes) demands curly quotes over straight double quotes, and the repo lints docs with Vale/pymarkdownlnt, not proselint. The repo's own doc generators (fix_curly_quotes in docs/_scripts/generate_cli_docs.py and docs/usr/tools/generate.py) convert straight quotes to curly, so these apostrophe edits are a house-style choice, not lint compliance — restate the PR or drop it.

issues.summary: Complete the partial apostrophe conversion across docs
issues.detail: docs/explanation/deploying-machines.md retains U+2019 apostrophes at lines 19, 27, 33, 42 and 80 (one in the paragraph right after the edited line), and ~36 other files under docs/ still use curly apostrophes. Because smartquotes is not in myst_enable_extensions (docs/conf.py:322), source punctuation publishes verbatim, so the site will render mixed straight/curly apostrophes; do one scripted repo-wide sweep or revert.

issues.summary: Convert remaining curly double quotes to one consistent style
issues.detail: Curly double quotes remain at manage-machine-groups.md:425, 429 and 437 (“deploy only machines with SSDs”, “big buckets”, “fault domains.”), use-cases-server-lifecycle-management.md:19 and 28, and what-maas-shouldn-t-do.md:46 and 50; manage-machine-groups.md:430 already uses straight double quotes, leaving three quoting styles in one section.

issues.summary: Split the two unrelated URL changes into a separate commit
issues.detail: The PR is described as proselint/apostrophe cleanup but also rewrites juju.is to canonical.com/juju (deploying-machines.md:40, verified live) and the FDE link in security.md; the link churn is unrelated scope and should be reviewed on its own in a separate docs commit.

issues.summary: Fix broken sentences on lines this PR touches in use-cases file
issues.detail: use-cases-server-lifecycle-management.md:31 has the broken sentence "...very large supercomputing installations. and its bare-metal focus..." (period should be a comma); line 15 has "in MAAS.(as referenced by" (stray period, missing space); line 71 has a stray period before the dash in "in 1-2 years.– and tooling". Worth fixing while those lines are already being edited.

issues.summary: Run docs linkcheck in CI; workflow only runs lint-md and html
issues.detail: .github/workflows/ci.yaml (docs job) runs only `make lint-md` and `make html` — no linkcheck and no vale — so broken links like the wiki.ubuntu.com 404 are not caught in CI even though `make linkcheck` (docs/Makefile) detects them.
